hero.headline: Power Your Community, Intelligently
hero.description: WattShare connects generator managers and subscribers on one platform — track meter readings, generate accurate bills, and manage subscriptions without the spreadsheets.

features.sectionTitle: Everything you need to run a generator subscription
features.sectionSubtitle: From metering to billing, WattShare handles the operational details so managers and subscribers don't have to.

items.title: Real-time billing
items.description: Bills are calculated automatically from live meter readings and your generator's tariff — no manual math, no surprises.

items.title: AI bill prediction
items.description: See a forecast of your next bill before it arrives, based on your recent usage trends.

items.title: Meter reading tracking
items.description: Every reading is logged and timestamped, giving subscribers and managers a clear consumption history.

items.title: Issue reporting
items.description: Report outages or billing problems directly from your dashboard and track their status to resolution.

items.title: Role-based dashboards
items.description: Subscribers, managers, and admins each get a dashboard tailored to exactly what they need to do.

items.title: Secure authentication
items.description: JWT-based auth keeps every account and subscription protected behind a proper login.

preview.sectionSubtitle: A live look at what managers and subscribers see the moment they log in.

trust.sectionSubtitle: Buildings and generator managers rely on WattShare to keep billing fair and transparent.
trust.quote1: Billing disputes dropped to zero once every reading was logged automatically.
trust.quote2: Subscribers finally know exactly what they're paying for and why.

steps.sectionSubtitle: Three simple steps from sign-up to your first bill.

items.title: Subscribe
items.description: Sign up and subscribe to your neighborhood generator with your ampere plan and contact details.

items.title: Get metered
items.description: Your usage is tracked through regular meter readings logged by your generator manager.

items.title: Pay & track
items.description: Receive accurate bills on time, pay through your preferred method, and track your history anytime.

footer.tagline: Smart generator subscription management for modern neighborhoods.
